name: uptick
description: Lists updates for Claude Code, plugins, skills-CLI skills, Homebrew, uv tools and winget packages in a pane, and runs one only after you confirm it.

checkCommand.title: Extra check command
checkCommand.description: Optional: a command (split like a shell and run without one; on Windows passed on as one command line) that prints JSON in the checker's schema; its items are merged into the list. Empty: only the bundled checks.

brewfile.title: Brewfile
brewfile.description: Optional: path to a Brewfile. Homebrew then lists only outdated packages named in it. Empty: every outdated package.

knownBroken.title: Known-broken list
knownBroken.description: Optional: path to a JSON file of upstream versions to hold back, shown as a note instead of an update; Skip in the confirm step adds to it. Empty: ~/.config/uptick/known-broken.json.

kinds.title: Kinds
kinds.description: Comma list of the kinds to show and update: plugin, skill, brew, uv, winget. Add uv to check uv tools; their names then go to PyPI (or your uv index) on every check. Add winget, on Windows, to check winget packages; winget upgrade then asks your winget sources (by default the winget community repository and the Microsoft Store) on every check; what winget sends them is not checked by Uptick. Add vulns to mark updates that replace a vulnerable version (brew vulns; osv-scanner for npm, Appium and plugins); package names and versions then go to api.osv.dev once a day (an hour after a failed scan).

hint.title: Update hint
hint.description: band: a line above the prompt when updates exist; status: a status line entry; off: nothing.

fetchOnOpen.title: Fetch on open
fetchOnOpen.description: Refresh marketplace and Homebrew metadata each time the pane opens (slow). Off: a session start fetches when no check has for a day, or press r (Check now) in the pane.
